_provenance.what: Server-side venue catalog used to recompute every order price (ADR-0008: never trust a client amount).
_provenance.source: https://cvm-pwa.orangesync.tech/menu.json (the file the shipped PWA at /order/ fetches as ../menu.json)
_provenance.how: curl -sS https://cvm-pwa.orangesync.tech/menu.json | jq '{venues: [.venues[] | {venue_slug, name, items: [.items[] | {sku, name, prices_by_order_method, available}]}]}'
_provenance.note: That file is itself a live capture of each venue CVM's `menu` tool result (see its own _provenance). Regenerate this copy when the upstream menu changes; do not hand-edit prices.

_rate_note: 1 EUR = 1000 sats, matching the shipped PWA's own display rate (app.js: `sats = n => Math.round(n * 1000)`). Override with SATS_PER_EUR in the service env.
_option_note: Mirrored from the shipped client (app.js: Bacon .15, Jalapeños .09, Extra cheese .12 EUR). The venue CVMs' option_group_ids are not priced in the captured menu, so a client-sent option token that is not in this table is recorded but charged nothing; see REPORT.md 'what this does NOT prove'.
